core_principles: Fusion: Spa Wellness meets Medical Precision
Emotion: Trust, Calm, Hygiene, Premium Care
Content Strategy: Storytelling through smiles and comfort
Visual Language: Generous whitespace, rounded approachability, soft confidence
anti_patterns: No generic 'Clinical Blue' (#0000FF) - use Soft Sky or Teal
No sharp edges - use pill shapes and rounded-xl
No dense text blocks - use airy typography

layout_grid.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 md:gap-8

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-primary text-white px-8 py-4 font-semibold shadow-lg shadow-primary/20 hover:shadow-primary/30 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 flex items-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: rounded-full bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 px-8 py-4 font-semibold hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all duration-300 flex items-center gap-2

cards.service: group relative bg-white p-8 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-sky-500/5 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 overflow-hidden
cards.testimonial: bg-slate-50 p-8 rounded-2xl border border-transparent hover:border-sky-100 transition-colors

inputs.default: rounded-xl border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all outline-none

sections.header: Sticky, glassmorphism effect. Logo left, Nav center (hidden mobile), CTA right.
sections.hero: Split layout. Left: Typography + CTA + Trusted Badges. Right: High-quality cut-out of Doctor or Immersive Clinic Photo with soft gradient overlay.
sections.services: Bento Grid layout. Each card emphasizes an icon + clear title. Hover reveals 'Learn More' arrow.
sections.about: Asymmetric layout. Text on one side, collage of 2-3 images (Doctor, Diploma, Clinic detail) on other.
sections.testimonials: Carousel or Masonry grid. Focus on stars and emotional keywords.
sections.appointment: Clean form on a soft surface (slate-50). Multi-step feel or clean vertical stack.
sections.footer: Clean, organized. Map integration essential. 'Gülüş Tasarımı Uzmanı' badge.

universal_guidelines: Always use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for headings and 'Inter' for body.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000). Use Slate-900 (#0f172a) instead.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Mobile images must be constrained to max-h-[60vh].
Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside cards.
Implement smooth scrolling (Lenis recommended but standard CSS scroll-behavior: smooth is MVP).
Add 'Gülüş Tasarımı Uzmanı' as a floating badge or highlighted text in Hero.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE tailwind.config.js to include the new colors and fonts.
2. INSTALL framer-motion for soft entrance animations (fade-in-up).
3. CREATE a Layout component that handles the Navbar and Footer.
4. USE Shadcn components for the Appointment Form (Select, Input, Calendar) but style them with 'rounded-xl'.
5. ENSURE the map is an iframe embedded in the Contact section.
6. USE the provided image URLs. Do not leave placeholders.
